einzeiler: Trump's midterm strategy, Lake Ontario, and the Republican convention.
kurzfassung: Jon and Dan analyze Donald Trump's new midterm strategy and his proposal to rename Lake Ontario. They discuss Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s handling of a measles outbreak, recent polling in Texas, and scandals related to Mike Collins's campaign. Additionally, South Carolina Senate nominee Annie Andrews joins Dan to discuss her campaign's momentum.
stichpunkte: Donald Trump's midterm strategy and the Republican convention
The proposal to rename Lake Ontario
Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and a measles outbreak in Pennsylvania
Polling regarding James Talarico and Ken Paxton in Texas
Nazi-related scandals concerning Mike Collins's Senate campaign in Georgia
An interview with South Carolina Democratic Senate nominee Annie Andrews about campaign momentum
beschreibung:
With his approval rating 20 points underwater, Donald Trump previews his new midterm strategy: telling voters to pretend he’s on the ballot. Jon and Dan break down how that will play, react to the president renaming Lake Ontario to “Lake America,” and preview the Republican Party’s midterm convention.
They also discuss Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s handling of a measles outbreak in Pennsylvania, new polling that has James Talarico up on Ken Paxton in Texas, and the unnerving number of Nazi-related scandals surrounding Mike Collins’s Senate campaign in Georgia.
Then, Annie Andrews, the Democratic nominee for Senate in South Carolina, talks to Dan about the momentum building for her campaign now that Darline Graham has won the Republican nomination.
